author: kycrafft
body:
With the downfall of Berzerk I am currently LFT.

IGN: kycrafft
Age: Teenager, not specifying, but mature in serious situations
Kills: 72k
Previous teams: BerzerkV2 (Tournament)
Prefered Position: I'm flexible but I would prefer a support or midfield position. I can defend, but there are better defenders out there
Pros:
  • Experienced: I have a lot of experience on Avicus, I played with Berzerk (Won the tournament) for all of the tournament games, and I have a lot of scrim experience.
  • Good teammate: I give clear calls, listen to leaders and work well with other players.
  • PvP:.... Uhhhhh, there's not a lot to be jealous of but I can make it work. I'm also good with a bow.
  • Cannon experience: I'm sort of slow at building cannons, but I can make whiskeys, spreads, routers, whips and basic icaruses.
  • Bridging: Can ninja bridge and staircase. Don't ask me to breezily, though
  • Misc: I can MLG water drop and blockplace. I have good patience and awareness.
Cons:
  • Shit computer: Lots of lag. And more lag. And I need to play on terribly low settings
  • I'm not always active; school and sports eat up most of my time.
  • I'm outclassed by a lot of players, PvP-wise
  • Salty to GrapeSmoothie
  • Defending: I can defend in DTM but not so well in CTW, sorry

Skype: gg.no.re69 + I have TeamSpeak
